description: jest-image-snapshot 6.5.2 compares with a stored image (B23e Phase 2c): a first run writes `v1`'s image, then `-t v1` under CI finds it and matches. The match reaches Jest's totals (`matched`), and with the image stored the matcher's `this.snapshotState._updateSnapshot` of `none` doesn't refuse it. Two files, one worker.
